about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file.

playbook.notes: First curated candidate, from the draft: the rocks and Growth Spiral, Omo at once (stock Forge casts its three-mana commander around turn six), the cards that find lands, then the landfall payoffs, which go down before the turn's land so the land triggers them (before_land), the ramp sorceries, and the big creatures (stock sits on its six-drops with seven lands). Left to Forge: the X spells (Hydroid Krasis, Finale of Revelation, Aggressive Biomancy, Nissa), Terastodon, Acidic Slime and Skullwinder (aimed as they enter), the instants, Treasure Cruise (delve), and four cards its AI never casts (Curse of the Swine, Beast Within, Summary Dismissal, Oblivion Stone) plus Mirage Mirror and Magus of the Candelabra, which need activations no rule makes yet. Pressure attack, highest life first.
